## Behavior

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Include public contract,
configuration, migration and Adapter compatibility changes where relevant.

## Validation

List checks performed and any skipped checks with their reasons.

- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior and failure paths.
- [ ] Public contracts, examples and documentation agree.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data or generated deployment contents are included.
- [ ] Any migration or runtime change was tested on disposable data/resources.
- [ ] Contributions are available under Apache-2.0 and third-party notices are preserved.
